summary: Measurable and of finite integral by the field exists_lintegral_le.

steps.lean:
(hk.exists_lintegral_le l).elim fun _ ⟨a, b⟩ ↦
  ⟨⟨_, hk.rec (by fun_prop), .rfl⟩, (b ..).trans_lt a⟩
steps.claim: By exists_lintegral_le there is c < ∞ with ∫ |k(xg, xy)| dupperMeasure(F, l) ≤ c for all g, y; and x ↦ k(xg, xy) is measurable (k is measurable): so it is integrable.
